panels.description: Bua-ji, a compact upright older woman in a severe mustard sari with a red-ink pen behind one ear, sits behind ledgers and mustard sacks. Guddu stands opposite with his permit folder. A visible desk calendar is marked ONE MONTH TO DIWALI, confirming the deadline is still ahead. Leave upper-left desk space for lettering.
A loan ledger lies open beside Saand’s unsigned bid papers awaiting Bua-ji’s approval. The ledger margin visibly notes OPEN BEFORE DIWALI. Keep the upper third clear for dialogue.
Guddu leans over a rough GODARAZ plan and points at four lanes, his folder tucked against him. Keep the upper-left plan margin clear for lettering.
Bua-ji closes the ledger. Behind it, an open cash box visibly contains a folded GODARAZ flyer. Keep upper-left space open for her short line.

items.speaker: BUA-JI
items.text: The warehouse is collateral. Miss the opening, it goes to Saand.

items.speaker: GUDDU
items.text: First we open, then we become stable. This is the normal sequence.

items.speaker: GUDDU
items.text: Four lanes. Imported pine. International standard, saab.
